The alarm rings, I hide beneath the sheet,
I prefer to stay in my little world, neat.
Responsibilities? They’re not for me,
I love to lounge and take life leisurely.
I’m a bit of a slacker, that’s true,
Laziness is my go-to.
On my couch, I drift away,
Letting time slip by day by day.
Projects pile up, I close my eyes,
Chores call out, but I nap instead, no surprise.
Procrastination, my dearest friend,
I’d rather laugh and let my worries mend.

Laziness is my go-to.
On my couch, I drift away,
Letting time slip by day by day.
